verdict.rationale: There is a single thin mention of 'Azure Copilot' generating Terraform configurations, implying a built-in AI assistant can perform delegated infrastructure tasks, but the evidence pack provides no further detail on scope, capabilities, or user experience of this assistant. Missing for 10: documentation of Copilot's full task range, first-party product pages describing the assistant, and independent/hands-on corroboration of its use.
